shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile with straight legs
horizontal band composed of repeated vertical/short strokes
schematic silhouette-like figures on natural stone surface
curved hook-like terminal forms (boat prows / animal heads)
justification: The clearest correspondence is that each surface carries a long horizontal band of tightly repeated short vertical strokes (the crew-lines of A, the hatched register of B) set against reductive profile animals rendered without interior detail. Otherwise they diverge fundamentally: A is flat red pigment applied to a rough horizontal rock face with a single dominant boat motif, whereas B is carved low relief on a shaped upright slab crowded with stacked registers of birds, quadrupeds and a disc, and the shared band even occupies opposite positions (low in A, high in B).
